items.difficulty_reason: 11 行、eta 构造的基变换相容：N^i = M^i⊗B，f 对应非零除子 g，子模 f^iM^i⊗B 在 (N^i)_g 中即 g^iN^i；eta-locally-free 引理给出两条到 g^iN^i⊗g^{i+1}N^{i+1} 的直和项包含；两包含在 g 处局部化后像一致，直和项包含由局部化确定，故 η_fM⊗_A B ≅ η_g(M⊗_A B) 典范同构。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-eta-base-change (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 28104-28112

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the base change of the submodules defining eta_f to the g-power submodules of N = M tensor B, the inclusion of direct summands given by the eta-locally-free lemma on both sides, and the agreement of the two inclusions after localizing at g, which forces the canonical isomorphism (source lines 28114-28124)
